scope: Ordinary UTXO funding of already signed TKR1 controls; opener and payer are distinct keys.
checks: Opener control signature remains under the opener key; payer key cannot replace it.
Actual TxScriptEngine accepts the payer funding signature.
Fee, payload and funding input amount changes invalidate the funding signature.
Funding equal to the requested fee is refused.
limitations: No native acceptance or public submission is claimed by this funding-only test.
Caller must obtain the current native Open charge and service slots; builder does not grant native authority.
